result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row displays two consecutive cards that are completely identical: same 'Green Bowl Poké' title, same food image, same '15–25 min' badge, and same '€0.90 delivery' price. This appears to be duplicated or placeholder data and undermines trust in the listing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each carousel card represents a distinct restaurant/dish with unique imagery, name, and metadata; deduplicate the data source or fix the rendering loop that repeats the same item.

issues.description: The two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards use a flat light-gray placeholder-style background for the image, which looks unfinished compared to the richer photographic backgrounds used by the 'Smash Bros' card and the 'Popular right now' cards.
issues.suggestion: Replace the flat gray image backgrounds with proper restaurant/dish photography or branded imagery to match the visual quality of the rest of the page.
